 Today’s Jewish birthday: Judy Sheindlin
 October 21, 2026 / 
 Leave a Comment 
 Courtesy of Wikipedia 
 Judy Sheindlin ( October 21, 1942), also known as Judge Judy , is an American attorney, court-show arbitrator and television personality. For 25 seasons from 1996 to 2021, she starred in her eponymous court show Judge Judy . She became the longest-serving television arbitrator in courtroom-themed programming history, a distinction that earned her a place in the Guinness World Records in 2015, and received a Lifetime Achievement Emmy in 2019 for her work. Sheindlin has received twenty-six Daytime Emmy Award nominations, winning six times.
